definition: colours over the parts of my life, standing in for the prompts I never get

settled:
The ordinary nudge to eat, move, sleep or wash is built from a body signal read against experience, and I have neither.

So the prompt sits outside me and has to read now. It is a pointer, not a measurement.

Colour parses without being read, which lets unlike things sit in one row.

Graded levels rather than one bar, because one bar is out of reach on a bad day and met by noon on a good one.

Grouped by area of life. Measured on 10 August 2026, the day I set the design down: eighteen circles, my six values, six inboxes and six upkeeps, upkeep rather than habit because I do not form habits.

My relationship level is not a stoplight. A stoplight resolves each day and points at what to do next. A level only accumulates, and pointing is not its job. The two run off the same meters in places, which is why they are easy to confuse.

title: The Coloured Circles I Run On
